name: Chongyun
notes: A Cryo burst sub-DPS and buffer (Melt or Freeze). KQM puts the Burst before the Skill; Game8's two builds are a sub-DPS with Emblem of Severed Fate and a burst support with Noblesse Oblige, so the card lists both sets, the buff set first as KQM does, and KQM's 2+2 Noblesse Oblige and Blizzard Strayer as an option. Wolf's Gravestone leads both weapon lists; Beacon of the Reed Sea and Serpent Spine are on both. Neither source gives stat goals; ER 150% is the low end of KQM's solo-Cryo range (150-175%), the usual Forward Melt team having one Cryo character (Double Cryo is 125-135%).
